page.overview:
Who is Roscoe?

"Roscoe is the gatekeeper at Thunder Hollow Speedway. He's amused when he meets rookies who think they're braves enough to run on Crazy Eight night and has fun watching them try to survive on the track. Despite that, Roscoe's a stickler for the rules: no escaping the track once the race starts; last car standing wins; and no cursing on family night. But swerving is encouraged."

In the film, after Lightning McQueen and Cruz Ramírez entered at the Thunder Hollow Speedway as "Chester Wipplefilter" and "Frances Betline", Roscoe greets them as newcomers and later he tells them that the race has begun. Roscoe closes the door and tells them the rules of the Demolition Derby and forced them to race against them.
